# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c24 P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** alive and married  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Titles:** class beauty and belle  <sub>[v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Philippa  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Phil Blake  <sub>[v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa is a noted beauty with curls, big brown eyes, and a crooked smile. She has warm brown tints that suit yellow dresses, and she is described as a dainty fairy of a bride. After having babies, she becomes noticeably thinner.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 c27 P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

## Personality

Phil is playful, charming, and frivolous, yet she is a loyal, unselfish friend who is entirely free from snobbishness. Though she can be indecisive and thoughtless, she possesses plenty of intelligence and a knack for easy small talk. She views young men as good chums and playfellows rather than romantic conquests, enjoying her popularity with good-humored charm.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c10 P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_

## History

Philippa Gordon enters Redmond College as a freshman and quickly becomes the class beauty and belle. She meets Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant at Old St. John's and instantly befriends them, using her high social standing to introduce them to Redmond society. During her college years, she resides at Patty's Place alongside Anne, Priscilla, Stella Maynard, and Aunt Jamesina. While torn between her two suitors from home, Alec and Alonzo, Phil meets Jonas Blake while spending a summer at Prospect Point and falls deeply in love with him. Despite her mother's initial objections to his modest career as a minister, Phil stands firm and wins her family's approval. After winning a mathematical scholarship, she marries Jonas in Bolingbroke shortly after graduation, changing her name to Phil Blake. She later writes a letter to Gilbert Blythe explaining that Anne's engagement to Roy Gardner is over, prompting Gilbert to resume his courtship of Anne. Phil and Jonas later welcome children and attend Anne's wedding at Green Gables.
